svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Reading a volatility surface through its two slices
svg.desc: A grid of implied volatility by strike (70 to 130 percent of spot) and days to expiry (14 to 728), coloured from dark blue for low volatility through teal and green to yellow for high. One row, the 84-day expiry, is outlined in orange and drawn on the right as a smile curve: implied volatility is highest for low-strike puts, lowest just above the money and turns up slightly for high strikes. One column, the 90 percent strike, is outlined in magenta and drawn as a term structure against days to expiry.
